thread:
Tara Singh: Pushed a focused PR to tidy the Dedicated provisioning page: migration checklist for reserved->dedicated, an autoscale FAQ blurb, and a compact SDK + CLI snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5102. Need quick eyes on SLA wording and the eviction note.

Evan Morales: Quick read 50. Two requests: 1) Avoid the phrase 'best-effort' on its own. Suggest: 'fallback tiers (burst/shared) are not SLA-backed and are subject to preemption.' 2) Add a note that scheduled maintenance and emergency mitigation can cause preemption.

Sofie Lin: On the autoscale YAML, include an explicit label example under allocation so it's discoverable. e.g.
```
allocation:
  name: team-orbit
  labels:
    tenant_label: "team-orbit"
    isolation: "tenant"
```

Rui Chen: Dropping a compact Python snippet for the SDK examples section (tested locally):
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.create_capacity(
    name="team-orbit-dedicated",
    region="us-west-2",
    scale_policy={"min_replicas":2, "max_replicas":8, "cooldown_seconds":300},
    labels={"tenant_label":"team-orbit","isolation":"tenant"}
)
```

Rui Chen: Also add a one-line in SLA/evictions: 'Dedicated capacity has SLA-backed latency targets; fallback tiers are preemptible for maintenance or capacity constraints.' Send to Legal for final phrasing.

Tara Singh: Thanks 50. I'll swap the wording, include the label YAML, drop Rui's SDK snippet, and bump the recommended cooldown to 300s with a short rationale. I'll also add a tiny smoke-test checklist: 1) migrate test tenant, 2) generate sustained spike, 3) confirm scale-up, 4) verify cooldown prevents rapid scale-down, 5) confirm labels appear in Console and observability dashboards.

Evan Morales: LGTM. One more: fix the handbook anchor that moved -> should point to `#capacity-modes`.

Sofie Lin: I pushed a 1-line commit replacing the anchor.

docs-bot: Lint OK. Link-check: replaced 1 stale anchor.

Tara Singh: I'll tag Legal after CI passes. If Legal approves the SLA sentence I'll merge. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:.
